statusText: Mapped policy state: STRONG_BLOCK_NO_NEW_RISK. Tail remains high after a weak Nasdaq session and a failed intraday rebound, while current NQ price-path evidence is unavailable during the CME maintenance pause.
recommendation: The public state remains high-Tail through the post-close pause. The next evidence checkpoint is the 22:00 UTC futures reopen, where renewed low-zone extension versus two-sided rotation will determine whether Tail stays high or decays.
headline: High residual Tail into the futures reopen after a weak Nasdaq session
body: Nasdaq closed 1.03% lower and the last delayed NQ reading before the maintenance pause remained in the lower quartile of Tuesday's range after a failed rebound. Brent settled at $94.65 and the 10-year Treasury yield near 4.79%, preserving cross-asset pressure. Strong Dell and Palo Alto after-hours results provide a partial technology counterweight, so Tail remains high but below critical.

lookbackSummary: Tail was in WATCH/low territory overnight, rose into elevated as the European-to-U.S. transition weakened, reached high during the cash session, briefly fell to elevated on a meaningful rebound, then returned to high as that rebound failed and late-session downside pressure resumed.
outlookSummary: Residual downside-path risk remains high into the 22:00 UTC futures reopen but is expected to decay if two-sided trade returns. The next major conditional risk cluster is Wednesday's U.S. session: ADP at 12:15 UTC, the cash open at 13:30, Factory Orders at 14:00, EIA petroleum data at 14:30, and the Beige Book at 18:00.

forecast.analysis: CME NQ is in its daily maintenance pause. The last delayed quote before the pause was about 29,133 (-1.29%), in the lower quartile of a 29,002-29,571 range; Nasdaq closed -1.03%. Oil and yields remain elevated, while strong Dell and Palo Alto after-hours reactions provide a partial tech counterweight.
drivers: CME NQ maintenance pause; last delayed quote remained in the lower quartile of Tuesday's range
Brent settled at $94.65 after renewed U.S.-Iran fighting
U.S. 10-year yield finished near 4.79%
Positive Dell and Palo Alto after-hours reactions offset part of the tech pressure

forecast.analysis: By the European pre-open, Tail is expected to remain elevated only if the overnight structure preserves downside efficiency. A broader range and deeper retracements would argue for lower path risk even if oil and rates remain uncomfortable.

forecast.analysis: Mid-European trade is a confirmation window. Continued alignment among NQ weakness, high yields and firm oil would preserve elevated Tail; a widening two-sided range would indicate healthier mean reversion.

forecast.analysis: Approaching the U.S. premarket, Tail remains elevated because Tuesday's weak close still matters, but no future continuation is assumed. The main check is whether fresh U.S. liquidity reinforces or rejects the overnight direction.
drivers: U.S. premarket participation begins to matter more
Whether overnight direction survives deeper liquidity
Tuesday's weak close as residual context

forecast.analysis: Late European trade carries modestly rising Tail as U.S. participation increases. Persistent low-zone NQ plus weak semiconductors would strengthen the downside case; recovery in index leadership would weaken it.
drivers: Late-European to U.S.-premarket handoff
Semiconductor and megacap participation
Overnight range position

forecast.analysis: U.S. premarket liquidity becomes more informative. Tail rises only if overnight weakness survives deeper liquidity without meaningful retracement; otherwise the prior session's high-risk structure should continue to decay.
drivers: Increasing U.S. liquidity before major scheduled data
Failure or success of deeper retracements
Rates response ahead of labor data

forecast.analysis: The hour before ADP is an event-preparation window, not evidence of a future move. Tail stays elevated because a large labor surprise could interact with already-high yields, but the release itself does not justify a high Tail score in advance.
drivers: ADP scheduled for 12:15 UTC
Event importance raises Stress before the print, not Tail by itself
Already-elevated Treasury yields

Opening-auction continuation is conditional, not assumed

drivers: Post-open extension versus mean reversion
Volatility decay after the data cluster

forecast.analysis: By mid-morning New York, the forecast returns Tail to the top of elevated unless repeated extension has survived the opening sequence. The main invalidation is durable recovery away from session extremes with broader technology participation.
drivers: Mid-morning New York retracement quality
Technology breadth and semiconductor behavior
Distance from session extremes

forecast.analysis: Late morning risk decays further if opening volatility has been absorbed. A renewed directional leg with oil or yields making fresh highs would be the main mechanism for Tail to remain above this path.
drivers: Late-morning absorption of opening volatility
Risk of a renewed directional leg from oil or yields
Breadth of two-sided trade

forecast.analysis: At the end of the 24-hour horizon, the base case is elevated but sub-high Tail. The score would stay higher only if Wednesday preserves a second consecutive session of low-zone trading, shallow rebounds and aligned cross-asset pressure.
drivers: Whether Wednesday becomes a second consecutive low-zone session
Depth of rebounds across the U.S. day
Cross-asset alignment into the horizon end

forecastDetail.comment: Current NQ is unavailable during the CME maintenance pause; residual high Tail reflects the weak close and aligned oil/rate pressure, partly offset by positive post-close tech results.
Reopen risk stays high only if low-zone trading and failed rebounds resume; recovery into the prior range would reduce Tail quickly.
Two-sided trade after the reopen would move Tail back to elevated, while renewed downside extension with cross-asset confirmation would keep the regime unresolved.
Overnight Tail remains elevated if NQ holds near Tuesday's lower range; deeper retracement toward the session middle would weaken the pathological-path case.
Early Asia Tail stays below high unless repeated extension emerges; stabilization in technology and yields would support further normalization.
The base case continues to normalize if price discovery is orderly; fresh low-zone extension or geopolitical/oil escalation would interrupt that decay.
